title: Checks for banned imports.
summary: Projects may want to ensure that specific modules or module members are not imported or accessed. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-tidy-imports and made it stable in v0.0.201.

title: Checks for relative imports.
summary: Absolute imports, or relative imports from siblings, are recommended by PEP 8: Ruff takes this rule from flake8-tidy-imports and made it stable in v0.0.169.
message_templates: Prefer absolute imports over relative imports from parent modules
Prefer absolute imports over relative imports

title: Checks for module-level imports that should instead be imported lazily (e.g., within a function definition, or an if TYPE_CHECKING: block, or some other nested context).
summary: Some modules are expensive to import. For example, importing torch or tensorflow can introduce a noticeable delay in the startup time of a Python program. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-tidy-imports and made it stable in v0.0.285.
message_templates: `{}` is banned at the module level

title: Enforces the configured lazy-import policy in contexts where lazy import is legal.
summary: Python 3.15 adds support for lazy import and lazy from ... import ..., which defer the actual import work until the imported name is first used. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-tidy-imports. It is in preview.
message_templates: Use a `lazy` import instead of an eager import
Use an eager import instead of a `lazy` import
